name: Fragment Storm
intel: Data Swarm: many fragile enemies at once. Single-target towers cannot keep up — you need AoE.

name: Runners Ahead
intel: Cyber Runner: the fastest ground unit. Slow Tower halts it — then finish with damage.

name: Swarm and Sprint
intel: Swarms and Runners together. Place Cannon at the chokepoint corner, Rapid beyond it.

name: Corner Crunch
intel: Fast units plus swarms. All cluster at the sharp corner — perfect Cannon placement pays off.

name: Speed Choke
intel: Final mix. Slow the runners, AoE the swarms, burst the tanks. No single tower handles all.
